text.p: NeoPath Inc said on Friday Accumed International Inc has protested NeoPath's patent for an apparatus used in its AutoPap Pap smear screening system.
Accumed, a laboratory diagnostic company, claimed it already had a patent that covered this technology, for the "rapid capture of focused microscopic images," NeoPath said.
But the U.S. Patent Office has already allowed NeoPath's patent, NeoPath said. The U.S. Patent Office was not immediately available to comment on the dispute.
Accumed was preparing a request to have the patent re-examined, NeoPath said.
Accumed was also not immediately available for comment.
NeoPath has an automated Pap smear screening system with proprietary imaging technology which identifies smears with highest potential for abnormality.
